error_reason: When instructed to scan/play the YouTube video to find timestamps with multiple species, WebSurfer only scrolled the page (showing comments/recommendations) and never interacted with the video player or timeline. This prevented gathering the necessary evidence and led directly to an incorrect final answer; had the video been reviewed as asked, the correct count could have been obtained.

hypotheses.rationale: When instructed to scan the YouTube video and identify timestamps/screenshots of multi-species moments, WebSurfer only scrolled the page and did not play or review the video content. This failure to engage with the video prevented any chance of finding the correct count and led to the incorrect final answer. Earlier orchestrator repetitions stemmed from this non-compliance.
hypotheses.check: Verify that at step 20 the WebSurfer did not play the video or navigate the player timeline to view frames; confirm the screenshot shows only comments/recommendations and no evidence of timestamp inspection or video playback. Compare with step 18/22 instructions to confirm mismatch.

evidence.discrepancy: Step 20 assumed to act on instructions to scan the video but only performed a page scroll showing comments/recommendations, with no interaction with the video player or timeline. This contradicts the requirement to view frames and extract timestamps/screenshots of multi-species moments.

preconditions.condition: WebSurfer is instructed to scan/play the YouTube video and identify timestamps/screenshots where multiple bird species appear simultaneously.
preconditions.evidence: Step 18: "Please scan through the video at this URL ... and identify the timestamps where multiple bird species are present on camera simultaneously. Provide the timestamps and take screenshots of these moments." Step 22: "Please scan through the video ... identify specific timestamps ... Note these timestamps and then provide screenshots from these specific moments."

postconditions.condition: WebSurfer plays or navigates the video timeline to inspect frames and collects timestamps/screenshots of multi-species moments.
postconditions.evidence: Step 20: "I scrolled down one page in the browser." Screenshot OCR shows comments and recommendations, not video playback or timeline. Step 24: "I scrolled up one page in the browser." Screenshot OCR shows comments section; no evidence of video player interaction or timestamps found.
